context_title: i said lets get weird ALL NIGHT

entries.query: i said lets get weird ALL NIGHT
entries.answer:
That’s a lyric from Little Mix’s “Weird People”: “We’re gonna get weird all night / I said now let’s get weird all night.”[1]

A fair warning, though: if you announce it with that much conviction, the night now requires at least one bizarre dance move, an aggressively specific snack, and a story nobody believes tomorrow.
